name: UD -> SOP rules v1.5 against v1.4 on a fresh held-out sample, focused on Romanian and the known v1.4 gaps
task: TODO.md 'Symbolic formalizer v1.5 (after ud-rules-v1.4, eval-ud-rules-v14-v1)'; eval/reports/current/ud-rules-v14/results.json open_issues and lost_rows.
kind: evaluation-only (CPU inference; no training, no LLM calls)

coordination.constraint: Another agent (translator-agent) is refactoring lib/symbolic-lm into LanguagesUtil + TranslatorService + SymbolicLM and running eval-translator-compare-v1, which calls the live lib/ud-to-sop code. lib/ud-to-sop/, lib/symbolic-lm/, lib/languages-util/ and lib/translator-service/ are not modified by this experiment until status/journal.jsonl records a `done` or `blocked` event from actor translator-agent.
coordination.translator_agent_preregistration_read: status/preregistrations/eval-translator-compare-v1.json (registered_at 2026-09-29T21:41:59Z). Its own recorded deviation: every row of datasets/formalizer-v1/dev.jsonl is already an exact partition of eval-symbolic-lm-v1's arms (roA 622 + roB 652 + mixed 732 + noisyRo 560 + noisyEn 787 + cleanEn 1778 = 5131 = dev.jsonl's length), so eval-translator-compare-v1 draws its RO (150) and mixed (100) rows from datasets/formalizer-v1/train.jsonl instead. That pool is disjoint from the sealed formalizer-v1 test, formalizer-ood-v1 and formalizer-wild-v1 suites this experiment samples from, so no row-id exclusion from it was needed for the fresh sample below.
coordination.development_scratch: Rule changes are prototyped in tools/research/ud-rules-v15-draft/ (a copy of lib/ud-to-sop's *.mjs files, loaded only via tools/research/ud-rules-v14.mjs's loadRules(dir) for this experiment's own scripts; not imported by lib/, server/ or any other runtime path) until translator-agent's done/blocked event, then ported into lib/ud-to-sop with the exported API kept backward compatible (same function names/signatures re-exported from lib/ud-to-sop/index.mjs).

systems.parser: Stanza 1.10.1 (EN default package, RO RRT) through training/python/ud_parse_worker.py on the CPU (device cpu; GPU left to the proofing agent)
systems.a: ud-rules-v1.4: eval/reports/current/baseline-ud-rules/frozen-rules-v1.4/ (identical to lib/ud-to-sop at draw time; verified byte-identical except the worker script, which is not part of the rules)
systems.b: ud-rules-v1.5: tools/research/ud-rules-v15-draft/ during development; ported into lib/ud-to-sop and frozen under eval/reports/current/baseline-ud-rules/frozen-rules-v1.5/ (SHA256SUMS) once translator-agent's coordination constraint clears and before any v1.5 conversion of a sample row
systems.host_normalization: sop/frames.mjs as in eval-ud-rules-v14-v1, reported beside strict, never instead of it

development.data: datasets/formalizer-v1/dev.jsonl only (never a sealed suite); RO failures analysed with tools/research/ud-rules-v15.mjs dev --language ro (400-row seeded sample, seed 5, and later the full 2,198 RO rows) and categorize (regex triage into the named v1.4-gap categories).
known_v14_gaps_targeted: Romanian claim tails ("„P" — se confirmă?", "— așa este?"): eval-ud-rules-v14-v1 lost rows fv1_011603_0_0, fv1_001307_0_0, fv1_009151_0_0, fv1_010812_0_0, ood1_000268_0_0 (text already disclosed in that experiment's results.json; used only for a direct-output mechanism sanity check, never scored against the sealed harness during development).
"de" + weekday kept as a noun modifier when nested inside a compound NP ("ședința de consiliu de marți"): eval-ud-rules-v14-v1 lost row ood2_000100_0_0.

"be held at/in" for where-questions (a named venue after "held" was mis-classed as `object` instead of `location` by the DS021 C3 facility convention, which the event-location sense of "held" overrides).
known_v14_gaps_not_reached_in_v1.5: TR-VERB (pre-tagged re-parse of a verb read as a noun after a name, e.g. "Kavya lectures in physics"): needs a second Stanza call, deferred pending translator-agent (shared parsing infrastructure) and further scratch validation.

TR-SINCE ("Since A; B, is it the case that C?" split at ';' and the following comma, each premise linked `because $s` from the query): needs multi-parse orchestration in convertParse, deferred for the same reason.
the "Context: … Întrebare: …" two-clause pattern (2.6% of sealed OOD per eval-symbolic-lm-v1): not analysed in this round.

Romanian impersonal/reflexive constructions beyond the claim-tail case ("se poate confirma", "se știe", "se spune", "se crede", "se presupune", "se consideră"): broad category, deferred to avoid an unvalidated blanket rule.
comparisons inside quantity phrases: not analysed in this round.
mixed-language messages (0/45 gained in v1.4): not targeted; out of scope for a UD-rules-only change.
rule_changes: index.mjs CLAIM regex: added Romanian tail markers "se confirm[ăa]" and "(a[șs]a|asa) este" (previously only lead-in/other-tail forms matched, so these tails were parsed as an ordinary clause instead of a claim-check marker).

index.mjs claimScope(): the quote-boundary lookup also matches the Romanian opening quote „ (U+201E), not only the Western “ (U+201C) or a straight \"; without this a Romanian claim quote's scope silently fell back to the coarser sentence-boundary heuristic.

index.mjs claimCheck(): factored the marker-vs-content test into isClaimMarker(relation, roles), extended with the Romanian reflexive-impersonal relation "se confirma"/"confirma" and a bare copula "fi" with no role but an inherited subject; applied to both the existing query-probe path and (new) to a same-shaped `stated` wire, since the Romanian tail sometimes parses as `stated` rather than `query` before this step runs.

analyze.mjs R11a (date-inside-NP): a bare weekday/month-name modifier now moves to a clause time only when it modifies the argument's own head or is an explicit NER/numeric date; a bare weekday nested inside a compound chain ("NP1 de NP2 de <weekday>") stays in the value.

analyze.mjs prepRole(): a new HOLD_VENUE lemma set ("held"/"hold", RO "ținut"/"ține"/"desfășurat"/"desfășura") forces role `location` for an "at"/"in"/RO "la" complement of an event-location sense of "hold", ahead of the general facility/organization -> `object` convention (DS021 C3), which otherwise does not distinguish an event's venue from an institution one works at.
development.validation_before_freeze: Each change was checked (i) structurally, via tools/research/ud-rules-v15-draft against constructed and (for the claim-tail fix only) the already-disclosed lost-row text, output inspected directly (not scored by eval/run.mjs or any harness) and (ii) for regressions, via a full paired dev run: RO dev.jsonl (2,198 rows) and an EN dev sample, ud-rules-v1.4 vs the draft, same parses, zero SOP differences outside the targeted patterns required before porting.

sample.size: 600 messages: 240 sealed formalizer-v1 test, 180 formalizer-ood-v1, 180 formalizer-wild-v1; 321 en, 235 ro, 44 mixed
sample.eligibility: every row except those consumed by eval-symbolic-layers-en-v1 (400, ids and semantic cases), eval-ud-rules-v14-v1 (600, ids and semantic cases) and eval-symbolic-lm-v1's oodRo set (the 395 clean monolingual Romanian rows of the sealed OOD suite); one row per semantic_case_id
sample.strata: source x language x question-type group x length (as in eval-ud-rules-v14-v1), proportional largest-remainder allocation with at least one row per non-empty stratum
sample.stages: nested stratified stages of 150 and 300 rows (seed 42) and the full 600
sample.rules_at_draw: ud-rules-v1.4 (lib/ud-to-sop byte-identical to frozen-rules-v1.4 at draw time)
sample.v14_predictions_frozen_at: immediately after the draw, via tools/research/ud-rules-v15.mjs convert --rules v1.4 --stage full (predictions-v1.4.jsonl); not scored or inspected until v1.5 is frozen

metrics.strict: unchanged harness: test/OOD execution_equivalent_tolerant of eval/run.mjs (row world); wild: D1-tolerant all-proposition F1 = 1 against any accepted gold (tools/research/ud-baseline-eval.mjs tolerantScores). This is the headline score (owner decision Q-SYM-1, carried over from eval-ud-rules-v14-v1).
metrics.frame_normalized: the same scorer after sop/frames.mjs host frame normalization rewrites the prediction (and, for wild, the gold too); always reported beside strict, never instead of it, per the task instruction 'strict (plus frame-normalized beside it)'.
metrics.secondary: mean D1-tolerant all-proposition F1; admitted (valid) output rate; the normalization gain (normalized - strict) per rules version

outcomes.primary: paired difference of strict match, v1.5 - v1.4, paired cluster bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples, seed 7; clusters = semantic cases), overall
outcomes.reported_slices: test, OOD, wild; en, ro, mixed; wild-en, wild-ro, wild-mixed; the same for the frame-normalized score and for the normalization gain; gained/lost row ids per slice are always reported, never silently accepted

hypotheses.H1: v1.5 raises the strict match rate over v1.4 on the fresh sample overall (95% CI excludes 0), driven mainly by the Romanian slice.
hypotheses.H2: No source or language slice gets worse: no slice has a 95% CI entirely below 0; every one of the 6 eval-ud-rules-v14-v1 lost-row patterns that recurs in this fresh sample is fixed, not merely not-regressed.
hypotheses.H3: The English slice does not move outside noise (the targeted changes are Romanian-specific or, for "be held at/in", narrow enough not to touch unrelated English rows): a 95% CI whose lower bound is materially negative would be investigated as a regression, not accepted.

stop_rules: Broken condition: at stage 150, more than 20% of v1.5 outputs are empty or not admitted -> stop, fix as a recorded deviation, restart on the same sample.
Harm: at stage 150 or 300, the 95% CI of the overall strict delta lies entirely below 0 -> stop and report v1.5 as a regression; do not proceed to the full 600.

Success is not a reason to stop early: the full 600-row CPU run costs minutes; it is scored unless a stop rule above fires. Every stage result is written (compare-150.json, compare-300.json, compare-full.json) and recorded.

Coordination stop: if translator-agent has not recorded a done/blocked journal event, v1.5 stays a validated draft (tools/research/ud-rules-v15-draft/) and is not ported into lib/ud-to-sop or scored on this sample; the task record and journal say so explicitly rather than silently completing partial work.
rigor: v1.5 is developed on datasets/formalizer-v1/dev.jsonl rows only; no sealed row (this sample or otherwise) is converted with a development version of the rules.
The v1.4 predictions on the fresh sample are frozen before any v1.5 rule change is ported into the live runtime.
Strict scoring is the unchanged harness; the frame-normalized score is labelled and reported beside it.
No training; GPU untouched (Stanza on CPU only); port 9999 untouched; only this experiment's own processes are started or stopped.
